cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：外部的
cards.example_en: Paint the external walls before the rainy season starts.
cards.example_zh: 在雨季开始前把外墙刷好。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：一般的；总的
cards.example_en: The general rule is to walk, not run, inside the corridors.
cards.example_zh: 总的规则是在走廊里走路，不要跑。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：理想的
cards.example_en: Sunny weather is ideal for a picnic in the park.
cards.example_zh: 晴朗的天气最适合在公园野餐。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：正常的
cards.example_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试前感到紧张是正常的。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：原始的；新颖的
cards.example_zh: 这是一个非常有创意的想法。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.example_en: She has the potential to be a great singer.
cards.example_zh: 她有潜力成为一名出色的歌手。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：特殊的
cards.example_en: Mum cooked a special meal for Grandma's birthday.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈为奶奶的生日做了一顿特别的饭。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：总的；全部的
cards.example_en: The total cost of the picnic food was twenty yuan.
cards.example_zh: 野餐的食物总共花了二十元。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：通常的
cards.example_en: We took the usual path through the park.
cards.example_zh: 我们走了公园里平常的那条小路。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：从前的
cards.example_en: Our former captain spoke to the squad before kickoff.
cards.example_zh: 我们的前任队长在开球前对队员讲了话。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：更久；不再

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：适当的
cards.example_en: Wear proper shoes when you run on the track.
cards.example_zh: 在跑道上跑步时要穿合适的鞋子。

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：宁愿；相当
cards.example_en: I would rather stay at home today.

cards.scene: 描述性状 · Description and Qualities
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：极好的；精彩的
cards.example_en: We had a wonderful picnic by the river on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 星期六我们在河边野餐，玩得特别开心。
